name: OutRun:R
source:
World Innocentrea, two years before game events.
Main character is a magician who meets a knight and another strange fellow on the way. They start travelling together fighting side by side.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事發生在遊戲事件前兩年的世界Innocentrea。
主角是一名魔法師，途中遇見一名騎士與另一名奇怪人物。他們開始結伴旅行並並肩作戰。

［譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-january-2008-fortune.html]vndbreview[/url]］
